profile_text.body:
IBM is a public company founded in 1911 and headquartered in Armonk, NY, trading under ticker IBM. Its OpenPages product page describes OpenPages as a highly scalable, AI-powered, unified GRC platform available on any cloud or on-premises, with modular components for governance, risk, and compliance. The page notes IDC recognized IBM as a leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide AI-Enabled Financial Governance, Risk, and Compliance 2026 Vendor Assessment.

IBM's AI products include OpenPages with Watson, a GRC platform with AI-specific modules, risk assessment, regulatory mapping, and Watson AI automated documentation; watsonx.governance, which covers AI lifecycle governance, model evaluation, monitoring, documentation, and EU AI Act accelerators, and was named a Leader in Gartner's first AI Governance Platforms Magic Quadrant in June 2026; and watsonx, an enterprise AI platform with agent inventory, behavior monitoring, and hallucination detection. The OpenPages page also describes an OpenPages MCP Server for AI agents to create, query, and update GRC objects, and API-based integration with watsonx.ai or third-party models. Citi partnered with IBM to automate its internal audit process using AI and machine learning, which the page says results in saving thousands of manual hours.

Legal exposure records show 448 entries in New York. IBM's most recent annual revenue on Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2025 was $67,535,000,000, and its SEC Central Index Key is 0000051143.
